ep01_shadows.title: Soya mening dostim
ep01_shadows.style: Upbeat Pixar style kids song, bouncy ukulele, playful marimba, handclaps, cute cheerful little girl voice, sunny vibe, 125 bpm
ep01_shadows.lyrics_uz:
[Short Instrumental Intro]
[Catchy Chorus: Cute Girl Vocal]
Quyosh chiqsa yugurib,
Orqamdan qolmas soyam!
Men sakrasam — u sakrar,
Quvnoq dostimdir soyam!
[Outro]
Soya, soya — quvnoq soyam!
Ko-rish-gun-cha, xayr dostlar!
[Big Finish]
[End]
ep01_shadows.subtitle_uz: 🎵 Quyosh chiqsa yugurib, orqamdan qolmas soyam! Men sakrasam — u sakrar, quvnoq do‘stimdir soyam! 🎵

ep02_plants.title: Suv ichadi gulcham
ep02_plants.style: Warm acoustic children's cartoon song, gentle guitar, kalimba, glockenspiel, cute young girl vocals, joyful nature vibe, 115 bpm
ep02_plants.lyrics_uz:
[Short Intro]
[Catchy Chorus: Cute Girl Vocal]
Shirin sharbat kerakmas,
Toza suv ber gulchaga!
Ildizlari suv ichib,
Boy chozadi quyoshga!
[Outro]
Yashnayvergin, gulginam!
Ko-rish-gun-cha, xayr dostlar!
[Big Finish]
[End]
ep02_plants.subtitle_uz: 🎵 Shirin sharbat kerakmas, toza suv ber gulchaga! Ildizlari suv ichib, bo‘y cho‘zadi quyoshga! 🎵

ep04_bees.title: Vizz-vizz asalari
ep04_bees.style: Whimsical garden cartoon song for kids, pizzicato strings, playful flute, ukulele, cute young girl vocals, happy bouncy tempo, 122 bpm
ep04_bees.lyrics_uz:
[Short Intro]
[Catchy Chorus: Cute Girl Vocal]
Vizz-vizz etar qanoti,
Guldan gulga uchadi!
Mehnatkash asalari,
Shirin asal yigadi!
[Outro]
Rahmat senga, bol-ari!
Ko-rish-gun-cha, xayr dostlar!
[Big Finish]
[End]
ep04_bees.subtitle_uz: 🎵 Vizz-vizz etar qanoti, guldan gulga uchadi! Mehnatkash asalari, shirin asal yig‘adi! 🎵

ep05_sharing.title: Birga oynash qanday soz
ep05_sharing.style: Heartwarming joyful kids friendship song, acoustic guitar, upbeat piano, tambourine, cute children singing together, cheerful, 120 bpm
ep05_sharing.lyrics_uz:
[Short Intro]
[Catchy Chorus: Cute Kids Vocals]
Oyinchoqni bolishsak,
Ikki hissa kop quvonch!
Birga qurdik kopriklar,
Dostlik — bu katta ishonch!
[Outro]
Birga oynash qanday soz!
Ko-rish-gun-cha, xayr dostlar!
[Big Finish]
[End]
ep05_sharing.subtitle_uz: 🎵 O‘yinchoqni bo‘lishsak, ikki hissa ko‘p quvonch! Birga o‘ynash qanday soz! 🎵
